name: GSProtect
author: wpvipezer

sections.description:
GSProtect keeps your WordPress content on the right side of Google’s spam policies, AdSense program policies and helpful-content guidance. It scans every post and page for policy risks (cloaking, scraped content, hidden text, doorway pages, restricted-monetization wording) and AI-style phrasing, then rewrites flagged text into natural, confident prose — before you hit publish.

Everything runs entirely on your own site. The analyzer and rewriter are a built-in local engine: no API key, no cloud, no third party ever sees your content.

  • 100% offline — zero network calls, zero data leaves WordPress.
  • Scans every post and page for Google spam-policy and AdSense-policy risks.
  • Rewrites robotic AI content into natural, human-sounding prose.
  • No license key, no email, no setup required.

Content Protection Lab

  • Site-wide scanner: audits every post and page for spam-policy issues and AI signals in one server-side pass.
  • Per-post audit: color-coded issue list (red = critical policy/AI, amber = quality, grey = UX) with live evidence snippets and “Locate in editor” buttons.
  • Posts-list badges: colored chips in the protection column so you can spot problem content without opening every post.
  • Schema, cloaking, duplicate/scraped-block, obituary-spam and restricted-monetization detection, plus a Google spam-update tracker.
  • Runs in resumable server-side batches — fast even on millions of posts.

Refine

  • Rewrites robotic AI phrasing (“It is important to note that”, “In conclusion”) into natural prose.
  • Replaces stiff wording (“utilize”, “leverage”) with plain words, tightens wordy sentences.
  • Tone presets: neutral, professional, friendly, conversational or authoritative voice.
  • Readability grade on every sample: Flesch Reading Ease and grade level, before and after.
  • Optional contractions mode (“do not” → “don’t”).
  • Four strengths: Light, Normal, Strong, Ultra.
  • Preserves links, images, shortcodes, list numbering and HTML.
  • Works in the classic editor, block editor, and the refine box below the editor.

Protect in bulk

  • Bulk Protect: one click rewrites every AI-flagged post with the offline engine, chunked in safe batches so huge sites don’t freeze.
  • Per-post flag to keep any single post’s content untouched.

Settings backup

  • Export/import your settings as a portable JSON file to move tone, strength and automation choices between installs.
  • Optional “delete all data on uninstall” preference: off by default. When ticked, deleting the plugin also removes settings, scan history and per-post flags.

Per-post control

Each post has a Refine on publish? setting on its edit screen, and posts that are too short to be meaningful are skipped automatically.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for GSProtect.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP, click Install Now and then Activate.

After activating, open GSProtect in the admin menu. The built-in engine is ready immediately — no setup, no key, no network.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin call an AI API?

No. The analyzer and rewriter are deterministic rules engines running entirely on your site with no network access. Nothing is ever sent anywhere by default.

Do I need a license key?

No. The built-in engine works on every site with no key, no email and no trial.

Is my data collected?

No. The plugin performs no analytics and no tracking. Scan results live only in your site’s own upload directory.

Will my post fail to publish if something goes wrong?

No. Processing is wrapped in safe error handling. If anything unexpected happens, the post is published unchanged.

Does this work with the block editor (Gutenberg)?

Yes. Refining and auditing work with both the block editor and the classic editor.

Can I turn off automatic refining for one post?

Yes. Edit the post and set Auto process this post to No in the sidebar panel.

Can I refine only part of a post?

Yes. In both editors, select the text you want to rewrite and click the Refine button in the toolbar. Only the selection is changed.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of GSProtect.
  • Site-wide content scanner for Google spam-policy, AdSense-policy and AI risks.
  • Built-in offline rewriting engine: no API key, no cloud, no setup.
  • Auto-refine on publish and update.
  • Bulk Protect for rewriting every AI-flagged post in one action.
  • Tone presets, readability grading and contraction mode for local rewrites.
  • Per-post override, settings export/import and optional delete-on-uninstall.
